default.description: User-controlled primary session model. RoleBench never automatically rotates or replaces it.

plan.description: Dedicated plan-mode primary with the ordinary ordered retry fallback chain; never weighted.

advisor.description: Dedicated advisor/watchdog model slot. Each configured advisor retains its own stable model runtime.

reviewer.description: Dedicated native /review model slot with structured review semantics; never pooled with advisor or helper traffic.

smol.description: Fast bounded helper work invoked on behalf of the primary model.

slow.description: Hard delegated reasoning and recovery work invoked on behalf of the primary model.

designer.description: Native designer-agent executions performed on behalf of the primary workflow.

tiny.description: Titles, metadata, classification, memory, and other tightly bounded utility operations.

task.description: Autonomous delegated child-agent execution, optionally specialized by a task pool lane.
